overview: This one-page file consists of a list-of-papers or cross-reference sheet for the subject “Sheep, Goats, Wool” in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records a June 14, 1935 despatch from Dairen by Grummon concerning an effort to increase Manchuria’s wool yield by importing American sheep for crossbreeding; the despatch itself was transferred or cross-referenced to decimal file 893.02222, concerning Manchuria.

people.name: Leland C. Grummon
people.role: Sender or author of Dairen despatch no. 29

subfiles.title: List of papers on sheep, goats, and wool in Kwantung
subfiles.about: The sheet records and redirects a 1935 Dairen despatch on importing American sheep to improve Manchurian wool production.
subfiles.summary: The list identifies Dairen despatch no. 29, sent by Grummon on June 14, 1935. The despatch reported efforts to increase Manchuria’s wool yield through the importation of American sheep for crossbreeding. A filing notation indicates that the report was placed or noted under decimal file 893.02222, Manchuria; the sheet also bears the incomplete date “Feb 16.”

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as evidence of State Department filing practice: the substantive despatch was redirected from the Kwantung animal-husbandry file to a broader Manchuria file. Its brief description nevertheless points to an important episode of agricultural modernization—the use of imported American breeding stock to improve Manchurian wool production—and identifies the date, origin, author, and filing destination of a report that must be sought elsewhere.
